facts.fact: The ministry's presentation states that a new sector policy declaration (Declaration de politique sectorielle) was adopted in January 2013 around four pillars: competition and investment, consumer protection, sector spillovers for the economy, and better regulation.

The ministry states that ICT development in Mauritania has been framed by the ICT Strategy updated in 2012, organised around six axes (access, legal and institutional framework, public service, e-government, digital economy, sector technology support).

The ministry states that, at the time of the presentation, an evaluation of the ICT strategy and the definition of its axes to the 2022 horizon were under way; no date is given beyond the document's own published date of 2019-04-04.
